name: Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
        
    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore
      
    - name: Build solution
      run: dotnet build --no-restore
      
    - name: Run tests
      run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal
      
    - name: Validate Aspire projects
      run: |
        # Verify Aspire projects exist and build correctly
        dotnet build GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj --no-restore
        dotnet build GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj --no-restore
        
    - name: Check project references
      run: |
        # Validate all project references are correct
        dotnet list GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj reference
        dotnet list GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj reference
        
    - name: Verify configuration
      run: |
        # Check that Aspire configuration files exist
        ls -la GZCTF.AppHost/
        ls -la GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/
        
    - name: Validate backward compatibility
      run: |
        # Ensure traditional build still works
        dotnet build GZCTF/ --no-restore
        dotnet build GZCTF.Tests/ --no-restore

yaml:
name: Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
        
    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore
      
    - name: Build solution
      run: dotnet build --no-restore
      
    - name: Run tests
      run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal
      
    - name: Validate Aspire projects
      run: |
        # Verify Aspire projects exist and build correctly
        dotnet build GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj --no-restore
        dotnet build GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj --no-restore
        
    - name: Check project references
      run: |
        # Validate all project references are correct
        dotnet list GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj reference
        dotnet list GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj reference
        
    - name: Verify configuration
      run: |
        # Check that Aspire configuration files exist
        ls -la GZCTF.AppHost/
        ls -la GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/
        
    - name: Validate backward compatibility
      run: |
        # Ensure traditional build still works
        dotnet build GZCTF/ --no-restore
        dotnet build GZCTF.Tests/ --no-restore
